scripts.check: bash scripts/verify_no_secrets.sh && npm run check --workspace client && npm run check:e2e && npm run check:tauri && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked ruff check server && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked ruff format --check server && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked python -m mypy --config-file server/pyproject.toml server/app && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked python -m pytest --rootdir server server/tests
scripts.check:tauri: cargo fmt --manifest-path client/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo check --manifest-path client/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.dev:server: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked python -m app.bootstrap && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir server --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --no-proxy-headers
scripts.dev:worker: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked python -m app.bootstrap && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked python -m app.generation_worker
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace client && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked ruff format server
scripts.tauri:build:customer: npm run require:customer-api-base && npm run tauri --workspace client -- build --config src-tauri/tauri.customer.conf.json --bundles nsis --no-sign --ci -- --no-default-features
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace client && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked python -m pytest --rootdir server server/tests
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test --workspace client -- e2e_contract.test.tsx && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --project server --locked python -m pytest --rootdir server server/tests/test_e2e_fake_provider.py
